name: Floor Dumbbell Tate Press
description: The Tate press performed lying on the floor, limiting range of motion at the bottom. The floor eliminates the possibility of excessive shoulder lowering, making this a safer variation. The triceps work intensely through the available range.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Floor Dumbbell Tate Press in the appropriate position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare equipment and body position for Floor Dumbbell Tate Press.
steps: Step 1: Lie on floor holding dumbbells with elbows flared to sides.
Step 2: Lower dumbbells in arc toward chest keeping elbows wide.
Step 3: Lightly touch or stop just above chest at floor.
Step 4: Press back to straight arms through tricep contraction.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale during the exertion phase, inhale during the return.
safety_considerations: Keep joints aligned throughout the movement.
Use controlled weight appropriate for skill level.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Move through full range of motion without compromising joint integrity.
coaching_cues: Elbows stay flared perpendicular to torso
